locator.section: 9.1 Hydrocarbons (alkylbenzenes; gamma-H rearrangement to the aromatic ortho carbon, tolyl-1-propane)

evidence.curator_note: Concerted gamma-hydrogen rearrangement to the aromatic ORTHO carbon with beta (C-alpha/C-beta) cleavage, expelling ethylene ('- C2H4' is printed over the single reaction arrow) and giving the OE+. rearrangement ion C8H10+., m/z 106, which the page labels. SUBSTRATE AS DRAWN: a propyl chain (three chain carbons; the migrating H is printed on the terminal gamma carbon, map 10) on a ring whose CH3 sits PARA to the chain, i.e. p-tolyl-1-propane, M+. m/z 134; measured on the scan the hexagon has vertical left and right edges with the chain on the lower-left vertex (map 1) and the CH3 on the upper-right vertex (map 4), which is the 1,4 relationship. ARROWS: Book draws 2 arc(s); moves <2> and <4> are drawn, moves <1>, <3> and <5> are implicit and required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). Drawn arc 1 (= move <2>) starts on the gamma C-H sigma bond (map10-map11) and points at the printed radical dot on the ortho ring carbon (map 2), i.e. into the forming map2-map11 bond; drawn arc 2 (= move <4>) starts on the C-alpha/C-beta sigma bond (map8-map9) and points at the map9-map10 bond, i.e. into the forming C-beta=C-gamma pi bond. The three arcs the book leaves implicit are: <1> the ortho radical's own odd electron completing the new C-H bond (the book simply drops the dot and prints two H's on that carbon in the product); <3> the second electron of the homolysed gamma C-H bond completing the C-beta=C-gamma pi bond of the expelled ethylene; <5> the implicit homolysis hook that puts the second electron of the broken map8-map9 bond on C-alpha, which the book prints only as the dot of 'H2C.' in the m/z 106 product. LOCALIZATION (convention B) / RESONANCE (convention C): the molecular ion is drawn LOCALIZED - '+' printed at the ipso ring carbon (map 1), '.' printed at the ortho ring carbon (map 2), ring Kekule double bonds drawn map3=map4 and map5=map6 - and this record uses exactly that canonical form of the delocalized arene radical cation; RDKit keeps both ions non-aromatic (0 aromatic bonds), so every bond-order change is integer and no delocalisation caveat is needed. The m/z 106 product is likewise encoded as the printed form: sp3 CH2 in the ring (map 2, carrying the transferred [1H:11]), '+' still on map 1 and the odd electron on the exocyclic H2C. (map 8). INTENSITY: no percentage is printed on p.240, so relative_intensity is omitted (convention F). The facing page (p.239) states in words that the C8H10+. rearrangement ion is 5.5% (m-tolyl-1-propane) and 0.9% (p-tolyl-1-propane) OF THE BENZYLIC-CLEAVAGE ION C8H9+ (Equation 9.17) - a fragment/fragment ratio, not a base-peak intensity, and not printed on this page. RELATED SCHEME: eq 9.15 (p.239) draws the identical reaction STEPWISE for a generic R (rH to a distonic intermediate, then alpha), whereas eq 9.16 prints it as one arrow, so it is encoded here as one step with no intermediate.

rule_index.json has NO chapter-9 entries (by_equation covers only 4.x and 8.x), so nothing is indexed under '9.16'. CLASS-LEVEL CROSS-LINK: IMS_4_36__rHalpha 'gamma H-migr. to unsaturated group Odd electron Ion 4.36 rH alpha' - '[C]1[C]2[C]3([H]4)[C]5[C]6[C+]7[C.]8[C]9{=}[C]10[C]11{=}[C]12{-}7 >> [C]1[C]2[C]3{=}[C]5.[C.]6[C+]7[C]8([H]4)[C]9{=}[C]10[C]11{=}[C]12{-}7' - encodes EXACTLY the bond changes of this step, and on the same localized ring: rule atom 7 = map 1 (ipso, keeps the charge), rule atom 8 = map 2 (ortho radical that receives the H), rule ring bonds 9=10 / 11=12 = the drawn map3=map4 / map5=map6 Kekule form, rule atom 6 = map 8 (C-alpha, becomes the radical), rule atom 5 = map 9 (C-beta), rule atom 3 = map 10 (C-gamma, donates H4 = map 11); the cleaved bond (6-5) is incident to atom 5, one atom of the new 3=5 pi bond, so the geometry is correct - this is the book's own eq 4.36, which the text on p.239 cites alongside eq 9.15. BUT IT DOES NOT MATCH THIS SUBSTRATE - RDKit-VERIFIED: the reactant pattern translated to SMARTS '[#6]-[#6]-[#6;!H0]-[#6]-[#6]-[C+]1[#6][#6]=[#6][#6]=[#6]1' gives 0 hits on this record's molecular ion, because the rule requires FIVE chain carbons (epsilon-delta-gamma(H)-beta-alpha) whereas tolyl-1-propane has only three and its gamma carbon IS the terminal methyl. Controls run in the same script: the same pattern truncated to the three propyl carbons matches this ion (1 hit), and the full five-carbon pattern matches the localized 4-pentyltoluene analogue (1 hit) - so chain length is the only reason it fails. The cross-link is therefore class-level, not substrate-level, and nothing here is claimed as computationally supported. ADDITIONAL FINDING: IMS_4_36_ ('4.36 charge move', '[C]1[C]2[C]3([H]4)[C]5[C]6[C]7:[C]8:...:7 >> ... [C+]7[C.]8[C]9{=}[C]10[C]11{=}[C]12{-}7'), the ONLY rule that would produce the localized [C+]ipso/[C.]ortho ring this record's precursor is drawn in, is dropped at import by the conservation guardrail in rules/__init__.py - verified by importing the package: '[rules] - gamma H-migr. to unsaturated group Odd electron Ion 4.36 charge move [charge 0->1, spin 0->1]' - so in the live rule set IMS_4_36__rHalpha has no producer for its left-hand side. MISMATCHES among the generic radical-site alpha-cleavage rules: IMS_4_9 '[C]1[C]2[C]3([C]4)[_A+.]5>>[C.]1.[C]2[C]3([C]4){=}[_A+.]5' and IMS_4_10 '[_A+]1[C]2[C.]3>>[_A+.]1.[C]2[C.]3' both require the charge and the odd electron to sit on the SAME atom ([_A+.]) or three atoms apart; this ion has them on adjacent but distinct ring atoms - RDKit-VERIFIED 0 hits for both (no atom carries both charge and radical). Both are also dropped by the same guardrail (spin 1->2), and IMS_4_9 additionally carries the known geometry defect (its cleaved bond 1-2 is incident to neither atom of the new pi bond).
